10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve retrofit kit, SV / DV valves become SCV
10.evidenceText: Source 1: Sale price: €7.90 Regular price: €9.95. Sale price: €4.90 Regular price: €5.99. Source 2: EUR 12,60 €. All prices: €4.90, €5.99, €7.90, €9.95, €12.60
10.extractionRationale: Multiple retail prices found across three sources. Source 1 lists four prices (€7.90, €9.95, €4.90, €5.99 for different Clik products/variants), Source 2 lists €12.60 for a 40mm tubeless valve set. Median of all five prices (€4.90, €5.99, €7.90, €9.95, €12.60) is €7.90.

27.evidenceText: Four distinct product URLs identified: p1859949.html (Clik Valve 60mm), p1859948.html (Clik Valve 40mm), p1960182.html (Tube No. 19 with Clik Valve), p1960181.html (Tube No. 17 with Clik Valve). Category page and accessories (pump heads) excluded.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs with individual product IDs (p-numbers). Excluded the category filter page (marken/schwalbe/f.serie) and pump head accessories. Tubes with Clik Valve are counted as distinct products, not accessories.

30.evidenceText: All 5 sources examined contain only product descriptions and titles. No stock status indicators ('out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', 'ausverkauft') found in any listing.
30.extractionRationale: Stock status cannot be determined from the provided text. Sources 3 and 4 have empty content, and sources 1, 2, and 5 contain only product descriptions without any availability or stock information.

61.evidenceText: the LME Official Price is the global benchmark price for aluminium, 25 tonnes Price quotation: US$ per tonne. Price graphs Shown in US$ view historical prices
61.extractionRationale: The provided evidence sources do not contain the actual current LME aluminum spot price value. Source 1 describes that prices are quoted in US$/tonne but provides no specific number. Source 2 contains aluminium alloy prices (not spot), and Source 3 contains premium prices (not the base spot price).
